text: Regorafenib is a multi-kinase inhibitor that demonstrates documented biochemical activity against the RET (Rearranged during Transfection) receptor tyrosine kinase. In the context of colorectal cancer, Regorafenib inhibits RET signaling by binding to the intracellular ATP-binding pocket, thereby preventing the autophosphorylation and downstream activation of oncogenic pathways that promote tumor cell proliferation and survival.
